labeled_methods_only: We analysed a cohort of 115 uterine mesenchymal tumours, which included nine PEComas and a broad panel of differential diagnoses, comprising leiomyosarcoma (LMS, n = 19), STUMP (n = 20), leiomyoma (n = 10), low-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma (LG ESS, n = 18), high-grade ESS (HG ESS, n = 13), adenosarcoma (n = 11), undifferentiated uterine sarcoma (UUS, n = 5), inflammatory myofibroblastic tumour (IMT, n = 3) and a collection of rare entities (1 UTROSCT, 3 KAT6B/A::KANSL1-, 2 PLAG1- and 1 NTRK-rearranged sarcomas). Immunohistochemistry (IHC) for GPNMB was performed, and a case was strictly defined as positive only if it showed diffuse staining (>75% of tumour volume) of moderate to strong intensity.
